recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of a bearded man in a patterned jacket holding a trumpet, set against a solid vibrant magenta-purple backdrop with a complex multi-level typographic header in the upper third.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally.
Typography is clustered in the top third, utilizing a mix of yellow and white for hierarchy.
The high-contrast magenta background isolates the warm skin tones and metallic brass of the instrument.
The fine texture of the houndstooth jacket provides a detailed counterpoint to the flat background.
coreInvariants: Subject wearing a black-and-white houndstooth or checkered blazer
Presence of a polished brass trumpet in the lower right foreground
Multi-weight sans-serif typography at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, centered, with the head positioned just below the vertical midpoint.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and dark beard act as the primary anchor, supported by the bright yellow title text above.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the yellow title, move down to the subject's face, then follow the line of the trumpet upward back to the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of flat magenta in the upper corners and around the subject's shoulders.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow (Primary title text) and Gold (Trumpet)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value contrast in the typography.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a heavy, italicized sans-serif with tight tracking.
Artist name uses an ultra-bold, extended geometric sans-serif.
Secondary text uses a lighter, condensed sans-serif.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between slanted yellow display type and rigid, extended white geometric type.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule-like spacing between text blocks
Small metadata text in top left corner

preserve: Extended width of the artist name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and slant of the top title line.
Captures the mid-century geometric feel of the artist name.
Alternative for the wide, heavy sans-serif name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a middle-aged man with a dark beard and short dark hair, smiling warmly. He is wearing a black and white houndstooth patterned blazer over a dark shirt. He is holding a gold trumpet in his right hand, visible in the lower right corner. The background is a solid, flat, vibrant magenta-purple. Lighting is soft studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add text in the upper third. Top line: Heavy italicized sans-serif in bright yellow. Second line: Ultra-bold extended geometric sans-serif in white, split into two large words with smaller white text nested between them. Third line: A list of song titles in small, condensed yellow sans-serif. Add technical metadata in the top left corner in small white sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid magenta?
Is the jacket a clear houndstooth pattern?
Is the top title line yellow and italicized?
Is the artist name white and extended?
Is the trumpet visible in the lower right?

adjustableVariables: Background color hue (e.g., deep blue or red)
Specific instrument held by the subject
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the top right
Original artist name and album title
Catalog numbers in the top left

mustAchieve: High-resolution texture on the houndstooth fabric

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow text is legible against the magenta.
Verify the houndstooth pattern does not create moiré effects.
Check that the trumpet looks like polished brass.
Confirm the typographic hierarchy matches the 1960s style.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Solid Vibrant Backdrop + Houndstooth Texture + Multi-Weight Sans-Serif Header
